items.title: Live: 'Shouldn't make stuff up': Minister criticises Joyce's suggestion China involved in Telstra outage
items.description: Telstra says services have been mostly restored after its mobile network suffered a nationwide outage on Wednesday morning. Follow live.

items.title: Broken timers trigger nationwide Telstra outage
items.description: Telstra says Wednesday's nationwide outage was caused by malfunctioning "nodes" that manage time synchronisation within some of the network data centres, but has no idea what caused the timer issues.

items.title: ICE arrests Australian accused of illegally voting in US elections
items.description: An Australian woman has been arrested in the United States after an ICE investigation allegedly found she had illegally voted in multiple federal elections.

items.title: Bondi survivor says YouTube's 'false flag' video decision 'inexplicable'
items.description: Arsen Ostrovsky has criticised a decision by YouTube to keep a video on its platform, in which creators suggested he had lied about his injuries from the Bondi Beach terror attack.

items.title: Iran's military command vows 'crushing response' to US strikes
items.description: The US military has launched a series of strikes against Iran after it said Tehran struck three ships in the Strait of Hormuz. Iran threatens a "crushing response".

items.title: 'We spoke for Palestine': Egypt fans on historic World Cup after heartbreaking loss
items.description: After initial disappointment after a late loss to Argentina, many Egypt football fans are joyously reflecting on the team's historic campaign, while using the stage to show support for Palestinians.

items.title: Watchdog scraps investigation into former anti-corruption commissioner
items.description: Investigations into allegations against Paul Brereton will end after the anti-corruption inspector found they would be too expensive to pursue.

items.title: What time is the State of Origin Game III decider tonight?
items.description: The men's State of Origin series will be decided tonight, as Queensland hosts New South Wales at Lang Park in a winner-takes-all Game III. Here is what you need to know ahead of kick-off.

items.title: The faces in the crowd at the Ayatollah's funeral
items.description: The strictly choreographed funeral of Iran's former supreme leader, Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, has presented a rare insight into the image Tehran wants to project to the world and the men they see as central to it.

items.title: Toddler waits seven hours for stitches during patient surge
items.description: A Central Victorian mother says she waited seven hours at Bendigo Health for her toddler to be treated for a head wound.

items.title: Qld business fined $1,200 after sparking million-dollar fire ant scare
items.description: The unnamed business shipped a pallet of second-hand bricks infested with fire ants to mine sites in the Bowen Basin in mid-2025, sparking four rounds of aerial baiting at a cost of $1 million.

items.title: Critical drugs could be pulled from PBS amid pricing stoush
items.description: The latest PBS stoush with drugmakers means thousands of people with MS are at risk of being forced to pay $33,000 a year for lifesaving medication.

items.title: Sale of Tasmania's biggest farm to UK pine plantation investor approved
items.description: The sale of Tasmania's biggest farm to the UK's largest forestry investor has been given the green light — with the news greeted by outrage from the state's farmers' group.

items.title: New York high-rise at risk of 'collapse' after columns buckle
items.description: The former headquarters of pharmaceutical giant Pfizer was being converted into luxury apartments when buckled interior columns were discovered inside the building.

items.title: A bus, a solar-powered stage and a journey across remote Australia
items.description: The Guts tour is a roaming, solar-powered convoy that snakes its way through some of the most remote communities in the Northern Territory, bringing together bands from the city and the bush.

items.title: Quiz: Jump in, we're going on a trip around the world
items.description: Which Mediterranean island was a setting for The Godfather? And what's the capital city of Morocco?

items.title: The 'amazing' turnaround in literacy at this primary school
items.description: An inspiring turnaround at an Aboriginal community school could provide a scalable solution for closing the gap on Indigenous literacy.

items.title: Prince Harry loses privacy case against Daily Mail, calls ruling 'whitewash'
items.description: Prince Harry and six other claimants, including singer Elton John, have lost their claims against Daily Mail's publisher after alleging their phones were tapped, voicemails intercepted and personal information obtained through deception.

items.title: Far-right UK MP resigns, triggering 'circus' by-election he vows to run in
items.description: Nigel Farage, the far-right political leader riding a surge of support in Britain, has announced a major gamble that could end his political career.

items.title: China missile test hits a bullseye in the Pacific — but it's one they didn't want
items.description: This week, perhaps for the first time in a long time, some sections of the Pacific are signalling a slight adjustment to their relationship with China.

items.title: Netanyahu flags new Trump rift with warning over jet sales
items.description: The Israeli prime minister has appeared on American TV to urge the US president not to sell jet fighters to Türkiye, adding to a growing list of tensions between the leaders.

items.title: IS-linked Australian accused of abusing Yazidi girl enslaved in her home
items.description: The last of the known Islamic State-linked Australian women in Syria is expected to return home amid allegations a Yazidi girl was enslaved, beaten and raped in the woman's home a decade ago, the ABC can reveal.

items.title: BHP workers to strike as negotiations with mining giant stall
items.description: Unionised workers at the mining giant's operations in Port Hedland will down tools for eight hours on July 16.

items.title: Aussie doubles fly the flag at Wimbledon as mixed pair makes final
items.description: Marc Polmans and Storm Hunter win through to the Wimbledon mixed doubles final, as Thanasi Kokkinakis flies the flag in the men's doubles.

items.title: With women's game short on resources this AFLW player went to Doha for ACL rehab
items.description: Essendon AFLW forward Emily Gough said devastating ACL injuries can get lost in the sheer amount of them in women's game.
